::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/list_views"}
#docs
`filters` uses the same `field` / `op` / `value` grammar the list endpoints take as `?<field>[<op>]=<value>`, and is validated against THAT list's own field and operator allow-list — a view cannot be saved holding a filter the list would later reject. A view must carry at least one of filters / search / sort / hidden_columns; an empty one would sit in the dropdown claiming to narrow something.

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | `string` | **yes** | The kind of list the view is for. |
| `business` | `string` | no | Omit for an org-level list |
| `name` | `string` | **yes** | The list view's name. |
| `visibility` | `string` | no | `private` is scoped to the caller; only the owner may ever edit or delete either kind. One of `private`, `everyone`. Defaults to `"private"`. |
| `filters` | `array of object` | no | The filters saved with the view. |
| `filters.field` | `string` | **yes** | The field to filter on. |
| `filters.op` | `string` | **yes** | The filter operator. |
| `filters.value` | `string` | **yes** | Comma-separated for `in`/`not_in`/`between`; a day count for `in_last`/`in_next`. |
| `search` | `string` | no | The free-text search saved with the view. |
| `sort_field` | `string` | no | The field the view sorts by. |
| `sort_desc` | `boolean` | no | True to sort in descending order. |
| `hidden_columns` | `array of string` | no | Column ids the view hides. null means the list's own defaults. |
| `is_default` | `boolean` | no | The view YOU land on for this list. Per owner — at most one. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list_view`. One of `list_view`. |
| `id` | `string` | lv_… |
| `entity` | `string` | Which list the view belongs to (subscriptions, invoices, …). |
| `name` | `string` | The list view's name. |
| `owner` | `string` | Who saved it. null for a view that belongs to the business itself. |
| `is_mine` | `boolean` | Whether the CALLER owns it — only the owner may rename, re-share, default or delete. Computed per request, never stored. |
| `visibility` | `string` | Who can see this list view. One of `private`, `business`. |
| `filters` | `array of object` | The saved filter set, in the list's own filter vocabulary. |
| `search` | `string` | The free-text search saved with the view. |
| `sort_field` | `string` | The field the view sorts by. |
| `sort_desc` | `boolean` | True if the view sorts in descending order. |
| `hidden_columns` | `array of string` | Column ids the view hides. null means the list's own defaults. |
| `is_default` | `boolean` | The view its owner lands on for this list. At most one per owner. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the list view was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the list view was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Created |
| `400` | Invalid filter field/operator/value, or an empty view |
| `404` | No such business |
| `409` | You already have a view by that name on this list |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/list_views" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "entity": "customer",
    "name": "Active subscriptions"
  }'
```
